title: potentilla glandulosa subsp. ashlandica
intro: Potentilla glandulosa subsp. ashlandica, commonly known as Ashland cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ashland cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
